title: fig04 GLMM reframed from crossed context x family design into two directly-asked questions (is it omission? does omission type matter?)
notes: User instruction: 'we must only focus on LFP-powerbands in relation to (1) is it omission yes/no, (2) is it omission of expected A or B or unpredictable [R is by definition random]'. Replaced the earlier crossed context x family interaction design (M0: context+family, M1: context*family, testing whether family modifies the stimulus-vs-omission gap) with two simpler, directly-asked models.

Q1 (fit_omission_yesno_glmm): db ~ C(context), all 6 conditions, session-nested random effects (groups=animal, vc_formula session-within-animal), Wald z-test. 13/20 area x band cells significant (Holm-corrected) -- differs slightly from the prior pooled-effect model's 14/20 because this version drops the C(family) covariate per 'only focus on' framing; both are legitimate, just different model specs.

Q2 (fit_omission_type_glmm): restricted to omission rows only (RXRR/AXAB/BXBA), db ~ C(family) vs db ~ 1, likelihood-ratio omnibus test (df=2), same random-effects structure. 0/20 significant -- consistent with the retired interaction design's null finding (does omission type/predictability change band power during the omission itself).

Descriptive panels redesigned to match: panel_omission_yesno (one bar per area x band, pooled paired difference) for Q1; panel_omission_type (three bars R/A/B, raw omission-window dB level, no paired counterpart needed since Q2 has no stimulus comparison) for Q2.

Caught and fixed a real, non-obvious layout bug during this pass: panel_omission_type's suptitle rendered fine in an isolated dpi=150 smoke test but clipped at both edges in the actual dpi=190 full-pipeline output. Root cause not chased (likely a DPI-dependent font-metric quirk); fixed robustly by shortening/wrapping the title and increasing header clearance, verified against the ACTUAL pipeline artifact this time, not an isolated re-test -- the isolated test had given a false pass once already.
fig04.svg/fig04.png now assemble three components: spectrogram+trace grid, Q1 summary, Q2 summary. Old fig04_glmm_context_family.svg/.png/_stats.md/.csv files deleted (superseded, not orphaned).
issues: fig04 remains unlocked/unsealed -- this is the second same-day GLMM revision (session-nesting fix, then question reframe); still needs full user sign-off before any lock/finalized-PNG step.

The lesson about isolated-smoke-test false negatives (panel_omission_type's title bug) is worth carrying forward for the rest of this figure's iteration: verify claims against the actual pipeline artifact, not a standalone repro, when dpi or other pipeline-specific parameters differ from the smoke test.
plan: No further action planned on this specific reframe. Awaiting user review of the two-question GLMM content before proceeding toward a lock.
